title: Momentum and Reversal on the Short-Term Horizon: Evidence from Commodity Markets
about: Investor-position decomposition of commodity returns into trading Q and orthogonal non-Q returns.
findings: Authors report return-based momentum and trading-based reversal at the same next-week horizon; not reproduced.
mechanism: Trend chasing and temporary investor-specific inventory pressure are proposed explanations.
build_on: Unique investor-position Q is absent. Do not substitute public COT aggregates or a price-only momentum rule.
code_feasibility: Requires full rules and actor-level data; no strategy implementation admitted.
